At nearly 5,900 square feet across three levels, this French Provincial limestone and brick residence is defined by a singular architectural vision: a soaring interior atrium with 30-foot ceilings and a south-facing glass block wall that floods the home with extraordinary natural light from the Brazilian cherry hardwood floors below to the high ceiling above. It is a home that manages to feel both grand and luminous, dramatic and deeply livable. The main level is designed for the full range of daily and celebratory life. A separate formal dining room - appointed with one of five antique fireplace mantels, each averaging over $20,000 - opens to a generously proportioned living room, also with a fireplace. The kitchen is equipped with a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf range and oven, Bosch dishwasher, granite countertops, and Perenti custom cabinetry. A spacious family room anchors the rear of the main level. A powder room and two-car detached garage complete this level. The home's outdoor space features a spectacular private in-ground swimming pool surrounded by an expansive patio - a coveted rarity in Chicago - plus a courtyard entry at the front. address: 1722 N North Park Ave, Chicago, IL
text: A Home With a Story. A Legacy Waiting to Continue. There are homes that are beautiful - and then there are homes that have a presence. 1722 N North Park is one of those rare Chicago residences where history, architecture and character come together in a way that simply cannot be recreated. A historic, oversized Italianate residence constructed in 1898, the home retains distinctive period details, including its classic bonnet-top windows, that speak to the craftsmanship and architectural character of another era. Lovingly owned and meticulously cared for by the same owner for the past 16 years, this truly special home, set on a 31.5 ft wide lot, is ready for its next chapter. Rich, beautifully maintained hardwood floors run throughout, complemented by a premium appliance package in the kitchen, and thoughtfully preserved details throughout the home. The exterior has been restored and maintained to the standards of the Chicago Historical Society, honoring the home's historic integrity while creating an exceptional first impression. Over its long history in Old Town, the residence has served not only as a private home but also as a church rectory and gathering place within the neighborhood's vibrant community history - adding another layer to the remarkable provenance of this special property. This is a home for someone who appreciates craftsmanship, authenticity and the beauty of a home with a past - and understands the privilege of becoming its next steward. Set in Old Town, one of Chicago's most coveted neighborhoods, 1722 N North Park offers the rare combination of historic significance, architectural personality and an exceptional location. A truly special Chicago home for a buyer who knows that the most memorable houses aren't simply purchased - they are discovered, cherished and passed on.
